turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi uncle, you're in the recovery area now, the operation is done. How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit groggy, but the hip pain is better than before lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain right now?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We'll give you something for that. Any nausea or feeling like you want to vomit?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's fine, small sips only for now. Any trouble breathing, or your throat feeling sore?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat a bit scratchy, but breathing okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected, you had a breathing tube in during the operation since we had to switch to a full general anaesthetic partway through. Do you remember anything from during the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing at all, next thing I know I'm here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good, that's what we want. We'll keep a close eye on your blood pressure and kidney function overnight given your history, and we'll restart your apixaban carefully once the surgical team clears it.
